### Packages
```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()


```
## Import data

```{r}
read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
penguins <- read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
```

## Data wrangling


```{r}
penguins |> count(island) |> arrange(n)

penguins |> relocate(year, .after = island) |> head()

penguins |> arrange (body_mass)
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len)) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(species, bill_len)
penguins |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(desc(body_mass)) |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()

##filtering in single criteria and combinations
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 3000) |> head()
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 4000) |> count()
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 4000) |> distinct(island)

##filtering with and/or
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & bill_len > 30) |> count()
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" | island == "Biscoe") |> count()

penguins |> filter(species ==  "Adelie") |> count()
penguins |> count(island)
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & body_mass > 5000)
penguins |> filter(sex == "male" | sex == "female") |> count()
penguins |> filter(body_mass < 3500 | bill_len < "35") |> count()

##Selecting
penguins |> select(species, island) |> head()
penguins |> select(bill_len:body_mass) |> head()

##Advanced usage of select
penguins |> select(starts_with("bill")) |> head()
penguins |> select(ends_with("s")) |> head()
penguins |> select(contains("_")) |> head(n = 4)
penguins |> select(!species) |> head(n = 4) ##selectign everything except species

penguins |> select(starts_with("bill") | starts_with("f") | contains("body_mass")) |> head()
penguins |> select(starts_with("b") | starts_with("f")) |> head()
penguins |> distinct(year) |> head()
penguins |> distinct(species, island) ## different combinations are possible



##mutate fuction usage
penguins |> 
  mutate(bill_dim_ratio = bill_len / bill_dep) |> 
  arrange(desc(bill_dim_ratio)) |> 
  select(contains("_")) |> 
  head()

penguins |> 
    mutate(body_mass_kg = body_mass/1000) |> head()

penguins |> 
    mutate(flipper_to_mass_ratio = flipper_len/body_mass) |>
    arrange(desc(flipper_to_mass_ratio)) |> head()

penguins |>  mutate(body_mass_kg = body_mass/1000) |>
mutate(heavy = body_mass_kg > 4.5) |>  head()

##mutate and case when
penguins |> 
  mutate(flipper_class = case_when(
    flipper_len < 190 ~ "short",
    flipper_len <= 210 ~ "medium",
    TRUE ~ "long"                       ##remaining or otherwise situation
  )) |> 
  distinct(species, flipper_class)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  mutate(size = case_when(
    body_mass < 2800  ~ "small",
    body_mass <= 3800  ~ "medium",
    TRUE ~ "big"
  )) |> 
  distinct(species, size) |> ggplot(
mapping = aes(x=species,
y=size,
colour = size)) +
    geom_point()


## grouping data
# Looks the same
# Note "Groups: species [3]"
penguins |> group_by(species)

penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarize(mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))

penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  filter(body_mass == max(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))



```
